title: Catalina Xtreme Parasail
specs: Flights up to 400 feet high, maximum allowed by FAA
Panoramic views of Avalon Harbor and Catalina Island coastline
Combined weight minimum 180 pounds, maximum 450 pounds
Private charters available for up to 12 guests
gap: Exact duration of standard flight not explicitly stated, only 8-10 minutes flight time and about 1 hour total experience
blurb: Guests are securely clipped into a parachute attached to a boat and lifted up to 400 feet for 8 to 10 minute flights over Catalina Island. The full experience lasts about one hour including boarding and preparation. Flights offer panoramic views of Avalon Harbor, Catalina's coastline, and marine life, with no water contact during the flight.
extraNote: Flights depend on safe weather conditions; may be rescheduled if conditions are unsuitable · Captain makes final decision on weight limits and safety · Discounts cannot be combined and apply only to 800 ft flights · Boat dock in Avalon Harbor · Year-round, weather permitting
